note: Curated, human-reviewable identity map for PDC players who appear under different teamName spellings in OpenLigaDB payloads (docs/DARTS-AUDIT.md section 3.4). Only entries with an evidence link are merged; anything not listed here keeps its raw name. Surname-only or heuristic merges are deliberately NOT performed (e.g. Michael Smith vs Ross Smith are different players).
